Defines an available cutout. On disk, cutouts are stored as ``cutouts/{interconnect}_{cutout}.nc``; the renewable-profiles rules consume the country-wide files ``cutouts/usa_{cutout}_{year}.nc`` (e.g. ``usa_era5_2019.nc``), downloaded from Zenodo unless ``enable: build_cutout`` is set. Referenced from ``renewable: {technology}: cutout:``.
